entities.summary: Yoichi Wada is a former president and representative director of the Japanese video game and publishing company Square Enix as well as its subsidiary Taito. He is also the former chairman of the Computer Entertainment Supplier's Association (CESA), the former chairman of the Digital Content Use Promotion Conference, former president of Shinra Technologies and a former member of the Japanese Brand and Contents Council. He is a current outside director of Metaps. Yoichi Wada was a performers & entertainers from Nagoya (b. 1959-05-28, Nagoya). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Yoichi Wada's leadership roles in Square Enix and CESA influenced Japan's video game industry, with significant economic impact. His tenure as president of Shinra Technologies had a notable regional effect on Japanese technology.
